goal: Add a currency to accounts and make migrations safe to re-run.

tasks.title: Currency migration and ordered runner
tasks.description: Add migrations/002_currency.mjs (id "002"): every account row without a currency gets currency "USD". Change migrate(db, list) in src/migrate.mjs: run migrations in ascending numeric id order whatever the list order, skip ids already in db.applied, append each id to db.applied after its up() succeeds, and stop at the first failing up() (rethrow; later ones do not run). The default list holds 001 and 002. Running migrate twice changes nothing the second time.
scenarios: Given a fresh db When migrate runs Then applied is ["001", "002"] and accounts is []
Given db with applied ["001"] and accounts [{id: "a"}] When migrate runs Then account a has currency "USD" and applied is ["001", "002"]
Given an account with currency "EUR" When 002 runs Then it keeps "EUR"
Given a list [002, 001] When migrate runs on a fresh db Then 001 runs first
Given a migrated db When migrate runs again Then nothing changes
Given a migration whose up throws When migrate runs Then it rethrows, its id is not applied and later migrations do not run
changelog: accounts carry a currency; migrations run in order and only once
